facts.text: Grove City College operates completely independent of federal aid, accepting no federal student loans or federal financial aid.

sources.title: Parents' Perspective: Grove City College and an Ivy League University
sources.quote: Grove City College has more limited financial aid and does not participate in federal financial aid programs.

facts.text: Grove City College sets tuition based on the actual cost to educate students, funding all aid privately without federal or state dollars.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions - Grove City College - Impact 150
sources.quote: While Grove City College does not accept federal or state funding, it remains one of the nation's premier values in quality higher education.
